mapper.select: SELECT status FROM mer_merchant WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT m.id,m.source_application_id AS application_id,m.name,m.category,m.status,s.id AS store_id,s.name AS store_name,s.location FROM mer_merchant m JOIN mer_store s ON s.merchant_id=m.id WHERE m.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.id,m.source_application_id AS application_id,m.name,m.category,m.status,s.id AS store_id,s.name AS store_name,s.location FROM mer_merchant m JOIN mer_store s ON s.merchant_id=m.id WHERE 1=1 AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ',m.id,m.name,m.category,s.name,s.location)))>0 ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mer_merchant m JOIN mer_store s ON s.merchant_id=m.id WHERE 1=1 AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ',m.id,m.name,m.category,s.name,s.location)))>0
mapper.update: UPDATE mer_merchant SET status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE mer_merchant SET name=#{name},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE mer_store SET name=#{storeName},location=#{location} WHERE merchant_id=#{id}
